THE ROAD AHEAD

One pregnant passenger. One panicking driver. One white Golf between them and the maternity ward.

Ahead lies every hazard rural Ireland can throw at a hatchback — wandering sheep, a tractor in no hurry whatsoever, oil slicks, roadworks, boy racers on the bridge, and a queue of folk who need something framed by Tuesday. Weave, jump, hit the ramps, and do not stop for the football top. Big Patsy waits for no one.
